title: Defiant Dance applies both the +2 and the -2 to the same unit instead of two different units
expected: Parser (packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-might.ts:143-186) matches the compound "Give X +N ... and another Y -M" pattern but swallows "another" in a non-capturing group, emitting sequence[modify-might +2 target{type:unit}, modify-might -2 target{type:unit}] with identical descriptors and no excludeBound (verified by running parseAbilities on the card text). In the engine, collectSequenceTargetSlots (game-definition/moves/play/targeting.ts:147-171) merges identical descriptors via isRestatementOf into ONE slot, so findSequenceLeadTarget yields a single play-time target prompt. handle_sequence (abilities/effects/sequence.ts:69-80) only routes per-slot when slots.length >= 2, so ctx.boundTargets=[A] is threaded to both steps and getTargetIds (_helpers.ts:49-50) returns the bound id for each -> +2 and -2 both land on A; with targets [A,B] both steps receive both ids. No card-level override exists for sfd-196-221.
observed: Played via UI (click card -> one target prompt -> Pouty Poro/Overzealous Fan): spell went on chain with targets=[one id]; after resolution the target had meta.mightModifier=0 and might stayed 2 (i.e. +2 and -2 both landed on it), the other friendly unit had no modifier at all, and no pendingChoice/second prompt ever appeared. Forcing two targets via executeMove(playSpell,{targets:[A,B]}) resolved with BOTH units at mightModifier 0 (each sub-effect applied to every target) instead of A=+2/B=-2. Parsed effect is sequence[modify-might +2 target{type:unit}, modify-might -2 target{type:unit}] with no per-effect target binding / excludeSelf.
